notes.title: Elite Update is Now Available!
notes.content:
Amarantine Update 1.1 "Elite" Highlights:
[list]
[*]New game mode
[*]Steam leaderboard integration
[*]Reworked main menu
[*]Small bug fixes
[/list]
To try a new mode simply click "New Game" > "Elite". In this mode you have limited health, endless waves of enemies and deadly fire wall behind you. Every 10000 points you will regenerate 1 health points. For each killed enemy you will receive score points that will be then uploaded to steam leaderboard. Top ten players will be displayed in the main menu screen. 

Also Amaranthine original soundtrack is now ready for purchase in steam store http://store.steampowered.com/app/465530/

notes.title: Upcoming Update for Amaranthine!
notes.content: Hello everyone! The new update is coming! This update includes new game mode called "Elite". In this mode you must fight the endless waves of enemies with limited health points and with firewall behind you. That firewall will instantly kill you if you touch it. Also your score will be uploaded to leaderboards. You can try it now by switching to "elite_windows_beta" branch in game preferences.
